race.comment: Tough finish. PERSIAN SPIRIT (13) got too far back and struggled to get into the Rupert Clarke when last seen. He comes back a few notches in grade now but still gets in very well with 55.5kg. Craig Williams takes the ride from a good draw and if he can jump as well as he did winning first up he'll go close. HARRY'S YACHT (12) has been good in two runs back, just finding the leaders too tough to run down in the Testa Rossa here second up. Should get a decent run here and can go one better. STEPARTY (5) resumes. He was racing very well last time in and looks a key hope when fresh. PINSTRIPED (2) comes back from the G1 Underwood. His effort prior behind Evaporate was excellent, with some luck in running he'll be charging home.
